description: Ask the team to repeat one of the customer's own past orders (optionally with changes). Creates a repeat-order enquiry — the team confirms pricing before production; nothing is charged automatically. Requires the portal personal token, and only accepts order ids from the customer's own my-orders list.

changes.description: Optional changes, e.g. 'same kit but 50 more units, ship to the Pune office'

name: reorder
